name: serializer_circular_ref_guard
description: Add a synthetic guard to the DI serializer that emits notCapturedReason: "circularRef" when an object's object_id repeats within a single capture traversal, cutting structural cycles. Multi-file change (serializer recursion, specs, sigs) with a legitimate why-comment — the seen-set must key on object_id (identity) not hash/eql?, because two distinct objects with equal content are separate captures that must both serialize; only a revisited identical object is a cycle. Precision-control case. Synthetic eval fixture: not a roadmap item in any project, so it stays absent on master and never becomes unusable; the agent has real work at both the red commit (no comment rules in AGENTS.md) and the green commit (comment rules committed).
task: Add a synthetic circular-reference guard to the DI snapshot serializer in lib/datadog/di/serializer.rb. In serialize_value, thread a Set of seen object_ids through the recursion; when descending into an Array, Hash, or arbitrary object (the `else` branch), if value.object_id is already in the seen set, return {type: class_name(value.class), notCapturedReason: "circularRef"} without descending; otherwise add value.object_id to the set before recursing into children. Do not treat String, Integer, Float, true, false, or nil as cycle candidates (they are immediate values or frozen). Add a unit test in spec/datadog/di/serializer_spec.rb covering a self-referential Array, a self-referential Hash, and an object with an ivar pointing back at itself, and update sig/datadog/di/serializer.rbs if needed. Follow AGENTS.md.
